main_text.p: In auribus Domini exercituum.) Comminatio,mala tam in domibus quàm in agris iniustè comparatis prouentura continens. βάτος cadus, aliâs laguncula, & est mensura liquidorum,ut olei,uini,&c. Acphi[?] siccorum est, significatq; modium, ac decimam partem cori. Ergo significat,uix decimam partem sementis recipiendam in messe.
VAE QVI mane surgunt.) Sextus locus contra crapulam,ebrietatem,& luxum in conuiuiis,præ-cipuè popularium.

Opus autem Domini.) Exaggeratio eorundem peccatorum, quòd uidelicet non respexerint illi crapulæ dediti ad proprium creaturarum Dei usum, qualem Apostolus describit 1 Timoth.4. uel quòd non curent animalia uentris,quid Deus ab ipsis exigat,sed pecudum more agant.

Propterea in captiuitatem.) Comminatio pœnarum propter crapulam impendentiu.Prima pœ-na,quòd abducentur captiui,maximè quia non habue-runt cognitionem: id est,immodica ingurgitatione ci-bi & potus obbrutuerunt, & sese recto priuarunt iudicio. Altera pœna, gloria cius: id est,præstantissi-mi quique uiri, qui gloriæ & ornamento esse potuis-sent, fame ac siti absumentur. Tertiam insuper pœ-nam notare uidetur, pestem uidelicet & contagiosos morbos mortem inferentes, ubi ait, innumerabiles in infernum descensuros. Descendere enim in infernum,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Acphi" (Hebrew measure gloss, possibly misprinted) is marked [?]. The Greek word βάτος is copied with its accent as far as legible. Lemmas and commentary are run into the column in smaller type; no separate marginal notes were found. Printed "s" and "f"-like long s forms were rendered as plain s. "impendentiu.Prima" is printed without a space and is kept as printed. Running head is given without the page number.
